_doc: YUMI-LAB Product Catalog — source unique du printer.cfg. Couches : board (tronc commun : pins, courants, sondes, homing, macros valables pour toutes les tailles) -> machine (geometrie seulement) -> hotend (tete, choisie dans le wizard : indetectable) -> hotend_type -> nozzle -> yms. Une valeur ne vit qu'a un endroit ; les commentaires d'origine sont conserves (_comment sur la section, _comments par cle, _notes = lignes commentees). Les macros n'ont aucune valeur machine : elles lisent printer.configfile.settings et la macro unique _YUMI_MACHINE (classe deduite de la longueur de l'axe X). slicer_label (tete, type de hotend) = libelle exact du profil OrcaSlicer (curr_print_head, curr_hotend), recopie dans la macro _YUMI_PRODUCT du printer.cfg genere et compare par PRINT_START.

detection._doc: Rules used by compose.py to turn the hardware composition (yumi-detect.py: boards read from the YUMI_CONFIG descriptor burned in each MCU firmware) into a product of this catalog. Descriptor fields: board= cpu= conn= device= x/y/z/e0/e1= mx/my/mz= piezo= lot= uid=. Machines are the components of layer 'machine' (device= is their id). machine_x_tolerance: demi-fenetre (mm) autour de stepper_x.position_max de chaque machine, utilisee par la macro _YUMI_MACHINE pour reconnaitre la machine a l'execution. defaults.hotend = CHROMAX_X12 : meme defaut que default_print_head des profils OrcaSlicer (une machine sans smartbox et sans choix au wizard = ChromaX12 + 2 YMS Lite) ; le direct drive est un choix explicite des deux cotes.

SMART_MAKER_1X.name: Smart Maker 1.x
SMART_MAKER_1X._doc: Tronc commun de toutes les machines Yumi sur carte Smart Maker 1.x : pins, courants, vitesses, sondes, homing, macros. Une machine (C235/C335/C435) ne porte QUE sa geometrie. Valeurs = lignee usine/QC (qc/qc_printer_*.cfg, sauvegardes pads 06/2026), commentaires d'origine conserves (_comment, _comments, _notes).

_comments.rotation_distance: valeur usine/QC (20T GT2 theorique = 40) : endstops et vis regles avec 39

sensorless_homing._comment: YUMI_SENSORLESS_HOME : homing X/Y multi-tap valide (module yumi_sensorless_homing)

_comments.run_sgthrs_y: 0 = rien reapplique apres le home. 150 empoisonnait le registre : le finally du module le posait apres l'autotune (sg4_thrs=50), meme sur un home avorte ; la phase 1 suivante heritait de 150 (coarse_sgthrs_y=0) -> faux stall 5.12 mm avant la butee, 'aucun contact', en boucle. Verifie C235 06/09 (claude-skills/sensorless-homing/historique-reglages.md, test 8)

extruder._doc: Chauffe et parametres d'extrusion communs. Les pins moteur viennent de la TETE : direct drive = moteur reel sur le driver E0 (motor_slot), CHROMAX = moteur fictif sur des pins libres (tete bowden, Klipper exige un [extruder] ; ce sont extruder0..N = les YMS qui poussent).

_comments.pressure_advance: 0 volontaire : le PA module l'amplitude (surepaisseurs aux angles, motion extrudeur pollue pour la detection YMS)
_comments.pressure_advance_smooth_time: bas pour garder le pic de retract lisible par les encodeurs YMS
_comments.lead_time: fork Yumi-Lab/klipper : decalage temporel du trapq extrudeur (depressurisation anticipee), valide en impression 06/2026 avec PA 0 + smooth 0.04

extruder_stepper._doc: Reglages communs a tous les slots E (tete DD sur E0, feeders YMS). Le sens et le ratio d'un slot se surchargent par tete (extruder_slot_overrides).

_comments.samples: probe one point 3 times get an average

bed_scan._comment: BED_SCAN_ZERO : cherche la plaque metal de reference (racleur perfore derriere le plateau) a la sonde inductive, sauve bed_detect_x/y/z

_comments.center_dx: centre X = plateau/2 + dx (mesure : C235 +7.5, C335 +8.5)
_comments.center_dy: centre Y = plateau + dy, coordonnees BUSE (sonde a +30 derriere) ; mesure : C235 -25, C335 -21
_comments.z_floor: le nez reste au-dessus du plateau pendant que la sonde est derriere : jamais sous ce Z (repere tap)
_comments.planes: plans scannes a partir du 1er contact (le champ inductif s'elargit en descendant)
_comments.accel: acceleration pendant le balayage (20000 = a-coups bruyants sur des mouvements de 2 mm)

filament_head._comment: capteur d'arrivee du filament dans la tete, lu par le module yumi_filament_head : YUMI_LOAD_TO_HEAD = avance par pas de `step` mm avec lecture du capteur entre chaque pas (procedure QC ; le homing continu a echoue 4/4 au banc 06/09), YUMI_UNLOAD_CHECK verifie le retrait ; SET_HEAD_SENSOR_BYPASS ENABLE=1 si casse

_comments.pin: ^ = tirage interne : sans lui la ligne du capteur flotte (lectures differentes d'un redemarrage a l'autre au banc)
_comments.speed: vitesse des pas de charge (mm/s) = F1000 du QC
_comments.step: mm entre deux lectures du capteur = depassement maximal apres detection
_comments.max_load: generous on purpose: the YMS->merger tubes vary per bench (800 cut a real load short on 06/09, YMS ticking all along); a jam is caught earlier by the YMS runout (50 mm without tick), an empty feed costs nothing
_comments.head_to_nozzle: mm a pousser apres detection pour amener le bout a la buse — A MESURER, 0 = on s'arrete au capteur
_comments.blind_load: capteur bypasse : la charge tourne quand meme, a l'aveugle, sur cette longueur (0 = total de la sequence _YUMI_TIP)
_comments.min_temp: chauffe minimale pour la partie head_to_nozzle (zone de fusion)

_comments.steps_per_revolution: Steps per revolution (1.8deg motors use 200, 0.9deg motors use 400)

gcode_macros.gcode:
[save_variables]
filename: ~/printer_data/config/variables.cfg

[exclude_object]

[gcode_arcs]
resolution: 0.1

[respond]
default_type: echo
default_prefix: echo:

[display_status]

[pause_resume]

[idle_timeout]
timeout: 99999999

[virtual_sdcard]
path: ~/printer_data/gcodes/
on_error_gcode: _YUMI_PRINT_ERROR

[gcode_macro _YUMI_PRINT_ERROR]
description: virtual_sdcard on_error_gcode: a print stopped by an error. Heaters off, print state back to idle, YMS sensors re-armed (T0 idle branch); no axis motion, the error may be a motion error
gcode:
    # printing_start drives the T macros and the YMS insert_gcode: left True by a stopped print,
    # the next boot's INIT_YMS T0 or the next insertion would run a load to the head
    SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=printing_start VALUE=False
    TURN_OFF_HEATERS
    M117 Print stopped on error
    # back to the idle state: the printing T macro had left only the active tool's sensor
    # enabled — an insertion into any other YMS would go unnoticed until the next boot.
    # T0's idle branch unsyncs every feeder, re-arms the sensors (fictive extruder move, no
    # axis motion) and releases the motors.
    T0

[gcode_macro _YUMI_POP_TOOL]
description: Pop tool position, single source for every macro that parks there (PRINT_END, CANCEL_PRINT, tool change): X = bed + approach_dx then bed + pop_dx (the slicer start block positions; X max is bed + 21 on every size), Y = position_max
variable_approach_dx: 7
variable_pop_dx: 20
variable_approach_speed: 26000
variable_pop_speed: 5000
variable_y_speed: 3000
gcode:
    {% set bed_size = printer["gcode_macro _YUMI_MACHINE"].bed_size|float %}
    {% set y_park = printer.configfile.settings.stepper_y.position_max|float %}
    G90
    G1 X{bed_size + approach_dx} F{approach_speed}
    G1 X{bed_size + pop_dx} F{pop_speed}
    SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT ACCEL=9000 ACCEL_TO_DECEL=4500
    G1 Y{y_park} F{y_speed}
    SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT ACCEL=20000 ACCEL_TO_DECEL=10000

[gcode_macro _YUMI_LEAVE_PART_AND_UNLOAD]
description: Shared by PRINT_END and CANCEL_PRINT. Off the part at once (the short fast retract of the tip sequence, lift), pop tool, then the tip-shaping unload with the head-switch release check. Nozzle still hot: heaters are switched off by the caller afterwards. Tolerates being entered already parked or partly retracted (slicer end block of an older firmware)
gcode:
    {% set z_max = printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.z|float %}
    {% set z_lift = 10.0 %}
    {% set tip = printer["gcode_macro _YUMI_TIP"] %}
    SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT ACCEL=20000 ACCEL_TO_DECEL=10000
    M106 S0
    {% if "xyz" in printer.toolhead.homed_axes %}
        # 1. leave the part immediately: the short fast retract of the tip sequence, lift,
        #    then travel to the pop tool
        SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=yumi_leave
        M83
        G1 E-{tip.first_len} F{(tip.first_speed * 60)|int}
        RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=yumi_leave
        G91
        {% set dz = z_lift if (printer.gcode_move.position.z + z_lift) < z_max else (z_max - printer.gcode_move.position.z) %}
        G1 Z+{dz} F3000
        G90
        _YUMI_POP_TOOL
    {% endif %}
    # 2. at the park: the tip-shaping unload (cut, slow pull, pull up into the PTFE) — one
    #    source for its speeds and lengths: _YUMI_TIP / YUMI_UNLOAD_TIP — then the head switch
    #    must have released (YUMI_UNLOAD_CHECK inside). Never over the part.
    YUMI_UNLOAD_TIP SKIP_FIRST=1

[gcode_macro CANCEL_PRINT]
rename_existing: CANCEL_PRINT_DEFAULT
description: Cancel print: off the part at once (short retract, lift, travel to the pop tool), then the shaping retract at the park
gcode:
    CANCEL_PRINT_DEFAULT
    SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=was_interrupted VALUE=False
    SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=printing_start VALUE=False
    _YUMI_LEAVE_PART_AND_UNLOAD
    M220 S100
    M221 S100
    ALL_FAN_OFF
    TURN_OFF_HEATERS
    M84

[gcode_shell_command yumi_setup]
# generator/prefs.py of yumi-config: writes the machine's preferences and asks Moonraker to
# restart Klipper — the klipper.service ExecStartPre (autoconfig --boot) regenerates printer.cfg
command: sh -c "python3 ~/printer_data/../yumi-config/generator/prefs.py --apply --set \"$@\"" yumi_setup
timeout: 60
verbose: True

[gcode_macro YUMI_SETUP]
description: Declare the machine's configuration in one line and regenerate printer.cfg — what the Printer Config panel does, from the console or remotely: YUMI_SETUP HEAD=CHROMAX_X12 HOTEND=LOW_WASTE NOZZLE=NOZZLE_04 [MACHINE=C235] [HEAD_SENSOR=1|0]. Klipper restarts.
gcode:
    {% set args = [] %}
    {% for k, v in params.items() %}{% set _ = args.append(k ~ '=' ~ v) %}{% endfor %}
    {% if not args %}
        RESPOND TYPE=error MSG="YUMI_SETUP: nothing to set (HEAD= HOTEND= NOZZLE= MACHINE= HEAD_SENSOR=)"
    {% else %}
        RESPOND MSG="YUMI_SETUP {args|join(' ')} — Klipper restarts with the regenerated printer.cfg"
        RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=yumi_setup PARAMS="{args|join(' ')}"
    {% endif %}

[gcode_macro T0]
description: Single extruder: the slicer's tool selection loads the filament to the head (sensor) instead of being an unknown command
gcode:
    YUMI_LOAD_TO_HEAD

[gcode_shell_command save_mesh]
# yumi-config scripts/save_mesh.py, symlinked into printer_data/config/scripts by install.sh
# (MESH_SCRIPTS_DIR): persists the bed_mesh profiles in the #*# block of printer.cfg exactly
# as SAVE_CONFIG does, but without restarting Klipper
command: sh -c "python3 ~/printer_data/config/scripts/save_mesh.py"
timeout: 30
verbose: True

[gcode_macro BED_MESH_PROFILE]
rename_existing: BASE_BED_MESH_PROFILE
description: LOAD of a missing profile builds it instead of aborting the print, and counts the prints on the current mesh (prints_since_mesh). The periodic refresh is never run from here: at refresh_every prints PRINT_END proposes it on the screen (_YUMI_MESH_REFRESH_PROMPT), the operator validates
variable_refresh_every: 20
gcode:
    {% set load = params.LOAD|default('')|string %}
    {% set sv = printer.save_variables.variables %}
    {% set prints = sv.prints_since_mesh|default(0)|int %}
    # only a LOAD from a running print counts: the welcome loads the mesh at every Klipper
    # start too (15 restarts in a bench day had pushed the counter to 20)
    {% set in_print = printer.print_stats.state == "printing" %}
    {% if load and load not in printer.bed_mesh.profiles %}
        # a machine that was never meshed: the sliced file's start g-code asks for a mesh
        # that is not there. Build it now (persisted, no restart), then put the nozzle zero
        # back where the start g-code had just set it (BED_DETECTION moved the Z frame to
        # the inductive probe) — the print goes on with the fresh mesh active.
        RESPOND MSG="bed_mesh: no profile [{load}] yet, calibrating it now"
        BED_MESH_CALIBRATE PROFILE={load}
        Z_TAP
        SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=prints_since_mesh VALUE=1
    {% else %}
        BASE_BED_MESH_PROFILE {rawparams}
        {% if load and in_print %}
            SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=prints_since_mesh VALUE={prints + 1}
        {% endif %}
    {% endif %}

[gcode_macro YUMI_MESH_REFRESH]
description: Reference plate scan (BED_SCAN_ZERO) then bed mesh, standalone: BED_MESH_CALIBRATE heats the bed to 65, soaks, saves without a restart and switches the bed off. Run from the screen prompt (or by hand); it never starts by itself
gcode:
    RESPOND TYPE=command MSG="action:prompt_end"
    M117 Bed mesh refresh
    BED_SCAN_ZERO
    BED_MESH_CALIBRATE
    M117 Bed mesh refreshed

[gcode_macro _YUMI_PROMPT_END]
description: Closes the screen prompt (the "Later" button)
gcode:
    RESPOND TYPE=command MSG="action:prompt_end"

[gcode_macro _YUMI_MESH_REFRESH_PROMPT]
description: Screen dialog (KlipperScreen and Mainsail understand action:prompt) when refresh_every prints were made on the current mesh: the operator validates or postpones; nothing moves without a tap. Called by PRINT_END
gcode:
    {% set prints = printer.save_variables.variables.prints_since_mesh|default(0)|int %}
    {% set every = printer["gcode_macro BED_MESH_PROFILE"].refresh_every|int %}
    {% if every > 0 and prints >= every %}
        RESPOND TYPE=command MSG="action:prompt_begin Bed mesh refresh"
        RESPOND TYPE=command MSG="action:prompt_text {prints} prints since the last bed mesh. Scan the reference plate and rebuild the mesh now? A few minutes, bed heated to 65 C."
        RESPOND TYPE=command MSG="action:prompt_footer_button Later|_YUMI_PROMPT_END"
        RESPOND TYPE=command MSG="action:prompt_footer_button Refresh now|YUMI_MESH_REFRESH|primary"
        RESPOND TYPE=command MSG="action:prompt_show"
    {% endif %}

[gcode_macro CAT_FILAMENT]
description: Retract filament to park position
gcode:
    {% set x_max = printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.x|float %}
    G1 X{x_max - 3} F8000
    G92 E0
    G1 E-30 F12000
    G92 E0
    G4 P5000
    G1 E-90 F5000

[gcode_macro MOTION_SENSOR_INIT]
description: Initialize YMS filament sensors
gcode:
    M82
    G92 E0
    G1 E50 F4000
    G92 E0
    M18

[gcode_macro CUT_FILAMENT]
description: Cut filament with speed profile
gcode:
    G1 X8 F42000
    G1 X-8 F300
    G1 X8 F42000

C235.name: YUMI C235
C235._status: valide sur le banc C235 (= qc/qc_printer_C235.cfg)

C335.name: YUMI C335

C435.name: YUMI C435
C435._status: geometrie issue de qc/qc_printer_C435.cfg — a valider sur machine

DIRECT_DRIVE.name: Direct Drive
DIRECT_DRIVE._doc: Tete direct drive : moteur reel sur le driver E0. [extruder] prend les pins du slot 0 (motor_slot), son TMC et son autotune ceux d'extruder_stepper (meme driver, meme famille de moteur). Sens PB10 non inverse et ratio 50:17 = valeurs du QC C235 en tete DD.

CHROMAX_X12.name: CHROMAX X12

extruder._comment: moteur FICTIF : la tete CHROMAX X12 est bowden (aucun moteur), ce sont les YMS extruder0..N qui poussent ; Klipper exige un [extruder], on le declare sur des pins libres de la carte

CHROMAX_X12._doc: Tete CHROMAX X12 : bowden, alimentee par les feeders YMS (extruder0..N sur les slots E, sens et ratio = defauts extruder_stepper du tronc : PB10 non inverse, MK12 50:17 — verifie sur le banc C235 06/09, comme le pad .3 et la cfg QC). Les pads usine .4/.5 et la C335 de juin avaient un YMS-1 BMG en sens inverse 57:11 : si cette generation de feeder revient, elle se declarera par une surcharge de slot (extruder_slot_overrides), pas dans ce defaut. [extruder] = moteur fictif sur pins libres (Klipper exige un [extruder]).
